description.narrative: Avrop för teknisk expertis inför bedömning och analys av ett eventuellt fas 3 stöd för att förbättra tillgång till krediter i DRK, speciellt för små- och medelstora företag. Avropet är kopplat till insatsen PASMIF 2 med UNDP (52070103). Avropet görs från Sida avropsavtal med FCG SIPU International #1803.

The support program to the Microfinance Sector (PASMIF) has just completed its second phase. The first phase covered the year 2006 to 2009 and the second phase 2010-2015. In total, 4 donors financed the program: Sida, Belgium, UNCDF and UNDP. The largest donor was Sida with 30 Million SEK for phase 2 support.
The UNCDF has now submitted a Concept Note to the Embassy for a possible PASMIF3 programme (a 3rd phase) with the objective to further contribute to poverty reduction and to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals for the DRC through the promotion of finance accessibility to all and to consolidate the achievements of the PASMIF2.
The now proposed contribution is a call-off order from Sida's framework agreement with FCG SIPU International on Agriculture, Employment and Market Development, framework agreement number 1803. The called-off consultant will support the Embassy with analysis of a possible 3rd phase support to PASMIF.
